capabilities: Open Markdown files, graphs, canvases, images, audio, video, and PDFs in a new tab by default
Focus an already-open tab instead of creating a duplicate when reopening a file or canvas
extras: The author states this is their first Obsidian plugin and asks users to report unwanted behavior on GitHub; the duplicate-prevention feature is toggleable.
problem: Obsidian opens files in the current tab by default, so users who prefer a new tab per file must adjust settings or repeatedly use modifiers.
summary: Tab-behavior plugin that opens Markdown files, graphs, canvases, images, audio, video, and PDFs in new tabs by default.
